For direct routing, reuse a fully paginated signoz_list_notification_channels result only from the same still-current prepared operation; otherwise call it, refreshing only if state may have changed. If none fits, ask the user or offer signoz_create_notification_channel with user-provided config; never guess or create automatically. V2 direct routing needs a channel on every tier and rejects preferredChannels; confirmed v2 policy routing may omit tier channels; v1 anomaly uses direct preferredChannels.

alert.description: Name of the alert rule. Must be unique and descriptive.

alertType.description: Signal type: METRIC_BASED_ALERT or LOGS_BASED_ALERT or TRACES_BASED_ALERT or EXCEPTIONS_BASED_ALERT.

annotations.description: Annotations like description and summary. Supports template variables: {{$value}} for current metric value and {{$threshold}} for the threshold and {{$labels.key}} for label values.

condition.description: Alert condition containing the query and threshold configuration.

absentFor.description: Minutes (equivalent to consecutive evaluation cycles when frequency is 1m) to wait with no data before firing an absent-data alert. Example: absentFor=15 with frequency=1m fires after 15 evaluations return no series.

alertOnAbsent.description: Alert when no data is received within the evaluation window.

algorithm.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Anomaly detection algorithm; the supported value is standard (z-score based).

compositeQuery.description: The composite query defining what data to monitor.

panelType.description: Panel type. Use graph for alerts. Defaults to graph.

queries.description: Array of queries. At least one query is required.

aggregations.description: Aggregation expressions for builder queries. For metrics signal use the object shape: [{metricName: k8s.pod.cpu_request_utilization, timeAggregation: avg, spaceAggregation: max}]. For logs/traces use the expression shape: [{expression: count()}] or [{expression: p99(duration_nano)}].

expression.description: Aggregation expression (logs/traces signal). Examples: count(), avg(duration), p99(duration_nano), count_distinct(user_id), sum(bytes). Do not set metricName/timeAggregation/spaceAggregation when using this shape.

metricName.description: Metric name (metrics signal only). Example: k8s.pod.cpu_request_utilization. Use alongside timeAggregation and spaceAggregation. Do not set expression when using this shape.

spaceAggregation.description: Cross-series space aggregation (metrics signal only). Common values: sum, avg, min, max, count. For histograms use percentiles: p50, p75, p90, p95, p99.

timeAggregation.description: Per-series time aggregation (metrics signal only). Common values: avg, max, min, sum, rate, increase, count, count_distinct, latest. Default by metric type: gauge→avg, cumulative counter→rate, delta counter→sum.

expression.description: Formula expression referencing other query names (e.g. A / B * 100). Used for builder_formula type.

filter.description: Filter expression for builder queries. Example: {expression: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500}.

expression.description: Filter expression using field operators. Example: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500. Use empty string for no filter.

functions.description: Post-query functions applied to the series. Required for anomaly_rule: wrap with {name: anomaly, args: [{name: z_score_threshold, value: 2}]}.

args.description: Function arguments. Example for anomaly: [{name: z_score_threshold, value: 2}].

value.description: Argument value. Can be number, string, or bool depending on the function.

groupBy.description: Fields to group by. Grouped dimensions appear as labels in alert notifications.

fieldContext.description: Field context: resource for resource attributes or tag for span/log attributes. Required for non-top-level fields.

fieldDataType.description: Data type of the field: string or int64 or float64 or bool.

name.description: Field name to group by (e.g. service.name or http.method or severity_text).

having.description: Having clause to filter aggregation results.

expression.description: Filter expression using field operators. Example: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500. Use empty string for no filter.

limit.description: Positive maximum number of result groups. Use 100 for standalone alert queries and formula results. Use 10000 for each builder query referenced by a formula because input limits are applied before formula evaluation.

name.description: Query name (e.g. A or B or C). Used as reference in formulas and selectedQueryName.

order.description: Query Builder v5 result order. Use __result desc for metrics and formulas; use the primary aggregation descending for logs and traces. This is the wire field order, not dashboard editor orderBy.

name.description: Field or aggregation expression to order by (e.g. timestamp or count()).

query.description: PromQL or ClickHouse SQL query string. Used when queryType is promql or clickhouse_sql. PromQL with OTel dotted metric names MUST use the Prometheus 3.x UTF-8 quoted-selector form: {"metric.name.with.dots"}. Underscored / __name__ / bare-dotted forms return no data. Read signoz://promql/instructions for the full guide (histogram patterns dotted labels pre-flight checklist).

signal.description: Signal type for builder queries: metrics or logs or traces. Required for builder_query type.

source.description: Data-source filter for metrics builder_query only. Set to meter to alert on Cost Meter (usage/billing) metrics such as signoz.meter.log.size; omit otherwise.

stepInterval.description: Step interval in seconds for time aggregation. Use 60 for metrics alerts.

type.description: Query envelope type. Must match compositeQuery.queryType: builder → builder_query or builder_formula; promql → promql; clickhouse_sql → clickhouse_sql. Also accepted: builder_trace_operator for trace operator queries.

queryType.description: Query type: builder for Query Builder or promql for PromQL or clickhouse_sql for ClickHouse SQL.

unit.description: Unit of the queried data (Y-axis unit). Used for value formatting in alert messages and for unit conversion with targetUnit in thresholds. Common values: percent, ms, s, bytes, ns, reqps, ops.

matchType.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Match type - same accepted values as threshold.matchType (at_least_once, all_the_times, on_average/avg, in_total/sum, last).

op.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Comparison operator applied to the anomaly score - same accepted values as threshold.op (above, below, equal, not_equal, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, outside_bounds).

requireMinPoints.description: Require a minimum number of data points before evaluating the condition.

requiredNumPoints.description: Minimum number of data points required when requireMinPoints is true.

seasonality.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Seasonality pattern for anomaly detection: hourly, daily, or weekly.

selectedQueryName.description: Which query name triggers the alert (e.g. A or B or F1). Required when multiple queries exist. Defaults to the first query name.

target.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Threshold value compared against the anomaly score.

thresholds.description: v2alpha1 only (threshold_rule, promql_rule) and always required, including when alertOnAbsent=true. Each threshold level (critical, error, warning, info) can route independently. Omit entirely for anomaly_rule - use condition.op/matchType/target there instead.

spec.description: Array of threshold specifications. Each threshold can route to different channels.

channels.description: Existing notification channel names for this v2 threshold tier. Direct routing requires at least one nonblank exact name on every tier; preferredChannels is not a fallback. Reuse a fully paginated signoz_list_notification_channels result only from the same still-current prepared operation; otherwise call it, refreshing if state may have changed. Confirmed notificationSettings.usePolicy=true may omit channels, but supplied names are validated.

matchType.description: How to evaluate the threshold. Canonical: at_least_once, all_the_times, on_average, in_total, last. Aliases accepted: avg (=on_average), sum (=in_total). Numeric 1-5 also accepted but discouraged.

name.description: Threshold tier: critical, error, warning, or info. Also used as the routing label - alerts carry threshold_name equal to this value.

op.description: Comparison operator. Canonical literals: above, below, equal, not_equal, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, outside_bounds. Short forms accepted: eq, not_eq, above_or_eq, below_or_eq. Symbolic accepted: >, <, =, !=, >=, <=. Numeric 1-7 also accepted but discouraged.

targetUnit.description: Unit of the threshold target value. If different from compositeQuery.unit the backend converts between them during evaluation. Common values: percent, ms, s, bytes, ns.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this alert monitors.

disabled.description: Whether the alert rule is disabled. Defaults to false (enabled).

Skipped entirely for anomaly_rule which uses top-level evalWindow/frequency instead.

kind.description: Evaluation kind: rolling (sliding lookback window) or cumulative (accumulates from a fixed daily/monthly reset boundary). Cumulative works for any period-total alert (e.g. daily error counts, monthly request budgets); Cost Meter spend budgets are one common use.

spec.description: Evaluation specification. For kind=rolling set evalWindow + frequency; for kind=cumulative set schedule + frequency + timezone.

evalWindow.description: Rolling kind only. Evaluation window as a Go duration string (e.g. 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 24h).

frequency.description: Evaluation frequency as a Go duration string (e.g. 1m, 5m, 15m).

schedule.description: Cumulative kind only. Fixed reset boundary the accumulation window starts from.

hour.description: Hour of the reset boundary (0-23); e.g. 0 for midnight.

minute.description: Minute of the reset boundary (0-59); e.g. 0 for the top of the hour.

timezone.description: Cumulative kind only. IANA timezone for the schedule boundary (e.g. UTC).

frequency.description: v1 schema only (anomaly_rule). Evaluation frequency as a Go duration string (e.g. 1m, 5m, 3h). For threshold/promql rules, use evaluation.spec.frequency instead.

labels.description: Labels for the alert rule. MUST include severity (one of critical, error, warning, info). When thresholds is used, threshold.name (e.g. critical) acts as the routing tier - set labels.severity to match the highest tier you want this rule to carry. Additional labels like team/service/environment enable routing policies.

newGroupEvalDelay.description: Grace period (Go duration string, e.g. 2m) during which a newly-appearing label group is excluded from evaluation. Helps avoid flapping when new pods/services come online.

alertStates.description: Alert states that trigger re-notification. Accepted values: firing, nodata. Other values are rejected.

interval.description: Re-notification interval as a Go duration string (e.g. 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h).

usePolicy.description: v2 threshold_rule/promql_rule routing mode only. false (default) requires at least one nonblank valid channel on every threshold tier. true routes through the org-level policy matching on labels, so threshold channels may be omitted; every supplied threshold channel name is still validated. spaceAggregation.description: Aggregation across series/dimensions. Auto-defaulted based on metricType. Valid: sum, avg, min, max, count, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99 (type-dependent).

temporality.description: Metric temporality: cumulative, delta, or unspecified. Auto-fetched when metricType is omitted; otherwise provide the metric's value when it affects aggregation.

timeAggregation.description: Aggregation over time buckets. Auto-defaulted based on metricType. Valid: latest, sum, avg, min, max, count, count_distinct, rate, increase (type-dependent).

timeRange.description: Relative time range. Format: <number><unit> where unit is 'm' (minutes), 'h' (hours), or 'd' (days). Examples: '30m', '1h', '2h', '6h', '24h', '3d', '7d'. Ignored when both start and end are provided. Defaults to '1h'.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Default: 10, max: 25 (capped to bound the docs index's memory footprint).

tools.description: Use this when the user wants individual log records or messages matching text, service, severity, or field filters. It returns paginated rows, not counts, trends, or grouped breakdowns; use signoz_aggregate_logs for those, and signoz_execute_builder_query only for queries this tool cannot express. You do not need the guide when using only searchText, service, severity, time, or pagination. Read signoz://logs/query-builder-guide before filtering on unfamiliar fields. Defaults to the last 1 hour.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds (optional). When both start and end are provided, they override timeRange.

filter.description: Filter expression using SigNoz search syntax (see signoz://logs/query-builder-guide). Combine conditions with AND, OR, and parentheses for precedence. Unknown keys hard-error; keys present in multiple contexts default to resource context. Disambiguate with attribute.<key> or resource.<key>. Log keys are workspace-specific; logs have no spec-mandated resource attributes, so even service.name is only present when the log pipeline sets it. Discover valid keys with signoz_get_field_keys, then confirm values with signoz_get_field_values, before filtering. Examples: "service.name = 'payment-svc' AND severity_text = 'ERROR'", "(severity_text = 'ERROR' OR body CONTAINS 'panic') AND k8s.namespace.name = 'prod'", "body.user.id = '123'".

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return (default: 100, max: 10000; higher values are clamped; paginate with offset)

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

searchText.description: Text to search for in log body (uses CONTAINS matching).

service.description: Optional service name to filter by (adds service.name = '<value>'). Fails with `key service.name not found` when this workspace's logs lack that attribute; discover keys with signoz_get_field_keys(signal="logs", fieldContext="resource") and filter on an available key instead.

severity.description: Filter on severity_text. Common values include DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, and FATAL, but they are not an exhaustive enum. Discover values with signoz_get_field_values(signal="logs", name="severity_text", fieldContext="log").

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds (optional). When both start and end are provided, they override timeRange.

timeRange.description: Relative time range. Format: <number><unit> where unit is 'm' (minutes), 'h' (hours), or 'd' (days). Examples: '30m', '1h', '2h', '6h', '24h', '3d', '7d'. Ignored when both start and end are provided. Defaults to '1h'.

It returns paginated spans, not aggregate trends/groups or a full trace hierarchy; use signoz_aggregate_traces for statistics and signoz_get_trace_details for one known trace ID. Read signoz://traces/query-builder-guide before using unfamiliar workspace fields. Defaults to the last 1 hour.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds (optional). When both start and end are provided, they override timeRange.

error.description: Filter by error status (true or false).

filter.description: Filter expression using SigNoz search syntax (see signoz://traces/query-builder-guide). Combine conditions with AND, OR, and parentheses for precedence. Unknown keys hard-error; keys present in multiple contexts default to resource context. Disambiguate with attribute.<key>, resource.<key>, or span.<key>. Discover valid keys with signoz_get_field_keys, then confirm values with signoz_get_field_values, before filtering. Examples: "service.name = 'payment-svc' AND has_error = true", "http_method = 'POST' AND (has_error = true OR duration_nano > 1000000000)". Combined with shortcut params using AND.

limit.description: Maximum number of span rows to return (default: 100, max: 10000; higher values are clamped; paginate with offset).

maxDuration.description: Maximum span duration in nanoseconds. Example: '2000000000' for 2s.

minDuration.description: Minimum span duration in nanoseconds. Example: '500000000' for 500ms.

offset.description: Number of span rows to skip for pagination (default: 0).

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

service.description: Optional service name to filter by.

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds (optional). When both start and end are provided, they override timeRange.

timeRange.description: Relative time range. Format: <number><unit> where unit is 'm' (minutes), 'h' (hours), or 'd' (days). Examples: '30m', '1h', '2h', '6h', '24h', '3d', '7d'. Ignored when both start and end are provided. Defaults to '1h'.

tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change an existing SigNoz alert rule; use signoz_create_alert for a new rule. This is a full replacement: call signoz_get_alert unless its complete result is available from the same still-current prepared operation, then preserve every unchanged field. Likewise reuse signoz://alert/instructions, signoz://alert/examples, and a fully paginated signoz_list_notification_channels result only from that operation; otherwise read/call them, refreshing only if state may have changed. If no direct channel fits, ask the user or offer signoz_create_notification_channel with user-provided config; never create automatically. V2 direct routing needs a channel on every tier and rejects preferredChannels; confirmed v2 policy routing may omit tier channels; v1 anomaly uses direct preferredChannels.

alert.description: Name of the alert rule. Must be unique and descriptive.

alertType.description: Signal type: METRIC_BASED_ALERT or LOGS_BASED_ALERT or TRACES_BASED_ALERT or EXCEPTIONS_BASED_ALERT.

annotations.description: Annotations like description and summary. Supports template variables: {{$value}} for current metric value and {{$threshold}} for the threshold and {{$labels.key}} for label values.

condition.description: Alert condition containing the query and threshold configuration.

absentFor.description: Minutes (equivalent to consecutive evaluation cycles when frequency is 1m) to wait with no data before firing an absent-data alert. Example: absentFor=15 with frequency=1m fires after 15 evaluations return no series.

alertOnAbsent.description: Alert when no data is received within the evaluation window.

algorithm.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Anomaly detection algorithm; the supported value is standard (z-score based).

compositeQuery.description: The composite query defining what data to monitor.

panelType.description: Panel type. Use graph for alerts. Defaults to graph.

queries.description: Array of queries. At least one query is required.

aggregations.description: Aggregation expressions for builder queries. For metrics signal use the object shape: [{metricName: k8s.pod.cpu_request_utilization, timeAggregation: avg, spaceAggregation: max}]. For logs/traces use the expression shape: [{expression: count()}] or [{expression: p99(duration_nano)}].

expression.description: Aggregation expression (logs/traces signal). Examples: count(), avg(duration), p99(duration_nano), count_distinct(user_id), sum(bytes). Do not set metricName/timeAggregation/spaceAggregation when using this shape.

metricName.description: Metric name (metrics signal only). Example: k8s.pod.cpu_request_utilization. Use alongside timeAggregation and spaceAggregation. Do not set expression when using this shape.

spaceAggregation.description: Cross-series space aggregation (metrics signal only). Common values: sum, avg, min, max, count. For histograms use percentiles: p50, p75, p90, p95, p99.

timeAggregation.description: Per-series time aggregation (metrics signal only). Common values: avg, max, min, sum, rate, increase, count, count_distinct, latest. Default by metric type: gauge→avg, cumulative counter→rate, delta counter→sum.

expression.description: Formula expression referencing other query names (e.g. A / B * 100). Used for builder_formula type.

filter.description: Filter expression for builder queries. Example: {expression: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500}.

expression.description: Filter expression using field operators. Example: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500. Use empty string for no filter.

functions.description: Post-query functions applied to the series. Required for anomaly_rule: wrap with {name: anomaly, args: [{name: z_score_threshold, value: 2}]}.

args.description: Function arguments. Example for anomaly: [{name: z_score_threshold, value: 2}].

value.description: Argument value. Can be number, string, or bool depending on the function.

groupBy.description: Fields to group by. Grouped dimensions appear as labels in alert notifications.

fieldContext.description: Field context: resource for resource attributes or tag for span/log attributes. Required for non-top-level fields.

fieldDataType.description: Data type of the field: string or int64 or float64 or bool.

name.description: Field name to group by (e.g. service.name or http.method or severity_text).

having.description: Having clause to filter aggregation results.

expression.description: Filter expression using field operators. Example: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500. Use empty string for no filter.

limit.description: Positive maximum number of result groups. Use 100 for standalone alert queries and formula results. Use 10000 for each builder query referenced by a formula because input limits are applied before formula evaluation.

name.description: Query name (e.g. A or B or C). Used as reference in formulas and selectedQueryName.

order.description: Query Builder v5 result order. Use __result desc for metrics and formulas; use the primary aggregation descending for logs and traces. This is the wire field order, not dashboard editor orderBy.

name.description: Field or aggregation expression to order by (e.g. timestamp or count()).

query.description: PromQL or ClickHouse SQL query string. Used when queryType is promql or clickhouse_sql. PromQL with OTel dotted metric names MUST use the Prometheus 3.x UTF-8 quoted-selector form: {"metric.name.with.dots"}. Underscored / __name__ / bare-dotted forms return no data. Read signoz://promql/instructions for the full guide (histogram patterns dotted labels pre-flight checklist).

signal.description: Signal type for builder queries: metrics or logs or traces. Required for builder_query type.

source.description: Data-source filter for metrics builder_query only. Set to meter to alert on Cost Meter (usage/billing) metrics such as signoz.meter.log.size; omit otherwise.

stepInterval.description: Step interval in seconds for time aggregation. Use 60 for metrics alerts.

type.description: Query envelope type. Must match compositeQuery.queryType: builder → builder_query or builder_formula; promql → promql; clickhouse_sql → clickhouse_sql. Also accepted: builder_trace_operator for trace operator queries.

queryType.description: Query type: builder for Query Builder or promql for PromQL or clickhouse_sql for ClickHouse SQL.

unit.description: Unit of the queried data (Y-axis unit). Used for value formatting in alert messages and for unit conversion with targetUnit in thresholds. Common values: percent, ms, s, bytes, ns, reqps, ops.

matchType.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Match type - same accepted values as threshold.matchType (at_least_once, all_the_times, on_average/avg, in_total/sum, last).

op.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Comparison operator applied to the anomaly score - same accepted values as threshold.op (above, below, equal, not_equal, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, outside_bounds).

requireMinPoints.description: Require a minimum number of data points before evaluating the condition.

requiredNumPoints.description: Minimum number of data points required when requireMinPoints is true.

seasonality.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Seasonality pattern for anomaly detection: hourly, daily, or weekly.

selectedQueryName.description: Which query name triggers the alert (e.g. A or B or F1). Required when multiple queries exist. Defaults to the first query name.

target.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Threshold value compared against the anomaly score.

thresholds.description: v2alpha1 only (threshold_rule, promql_rule) and always required, including when alertOnAbsent=true. Each threshold level (critical, error, warning, info) can route independently. Omit entirely for anomaly_rule - use condition.op/matchType/target there instead.

kind.description: Threshold kind. Currently only basic is supported.

spec.description: Array of threshold specifications. Each threshold can route to different channels.

channels.description: Existing notification channel names for this v2 threshold tier. Direct routing requires at least one nonblank exact name on every tier; preferredChannels is not a fallback. Reuse a fully paginated signoz_list_notification_channels result only from the same still-current prepared operation; otherwise call it, refreshing if state may have changed. Confirmed notificationSettings.usePolicy=true may omit channels, but supplied names are validated.

matchType.description: How to evaluate the threshold. Canonical: at_least_once, all_the_times, on_average, in_total, last. Aliases accepted: avg (=on_average), sum (=in_total). Numeric 1-5 also accepted but discouraged.

name.description: Threshold tier: critical, error, warning, or info. Also used as the routing label - alerts carry threshold_name equal to this value.

op.description: Comparison operator. Canonical literals: above, below, equal, not_equal, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, outside_bounds. Short forms accepted: eq, not_eq, above_or_eq, below_or_eq. Symbolic accepted: >, <, =, !=, >=, <=. Numeric 1-7 also accepted but discouraged.

recoveryTarget.description: Hysteresis - value at which a firing alert is considered resolved. Useful to avoid flapping near the threshold (e.g. target=80 percent, recoveryTarget=75 percent). Use null to use the threshold target itself as the recovery point.

targetUnit.description: Unit of the threshold target value. If different from compositeQuery.unit the backend converts between them during evaluation. Common values: percent, ms, s, bytes, ns.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this alert monitors.

disabled.description: Whether the alert rule is disabled. Defaults to false (enabled).

evalWindow.description: v1 schema only (anomaly_rule). Evaluation window as a Go duration string (e.g. 5m, 15m, 1h, 24h). For threshold/promql rules, use evaluation.spec.evalWindow instead.

evaluation.description: v2alpha1 only. Evaluation configuration. kind=rolling (sliding window) auto-generated with defaults (5m/1m) if omitted; kind=cumulative (daily/monthly reset) for period-total alerts such as daily error counts or Cost Meter spend budgets. Skipped entirely for anomaly_rule which uses top-level evalWindow/frequency instead.

kind.description: Evaluation kind: rolling (sliding lookback window) or cumulative (accumulates from a fixed daily/monthly reset boundary). Cumulative works for any period-total alert (e.g. daily error counts, monthly request budgets); Cost Meter spend budgets are one common use.

spec.description: Evaluation specification. For kind=rolling set evalWindow + frequency; for kind=cumulative set schedule + frequency + timezone.

evalWindow.description: Rolling kind only. Evaluation window as a Go duration string (e.g. 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 24h).

frequency.description: Evaluation frequency as a Go duration string (e.g. 1m, 5m, 15m).

schedule.description: Cumulative kind only. Fixed reset boundary the accumulation window starts from.

hour.description: Hour of the reset boundary (0-23); e.g. 0 for midnight.

minute.description: Minute of the reset boundary (0-59); e.g. 0 for the top of the hour.

timezone.description: Cumulative kind only. IANA timezone for the schedule boundary (e.g. UTC).

frequency.description: v1 schema only (anomaly_rule). Evaluation frequency as a Go duration string (e.g. 1m, 5m, 3h). For threshold/promql rules, use evaluation.spec.frequency instead.

id.description: UUIDv7 of the alert rule to update (required). Obtain it from signoz_list_alert_rules or signoz_get_alert.

labels.description: Labels for the alert rule. MUST include severity (one of critical, error, warning, info). When thresholds is used, threshold.name (e.g. critical) acts as the routing tier - set labels.severity to match the highest tier you want this rule to carry. Additional labels like team/service/environment enable routing policies.

notificationSettings.description: v2alpha1 only. Notification settings - controls grouping and re-notification behavior. Auto-generated with defaults if omitted.

groupBy.description: Fields to group alert notifications by (e.g. service.name, k8s.namespace.name). Reduces notification noise by batching alerts with the same group key.

newGroupEvalDelay.description: Grace period (Go duration string, e.g. 2m) during which a newly-appearing label group is excluded from evaluation. Helps avoid flapping when new pods/services come online.

alertStates.description: Alert states that trigger re-notification. Accepted values: firing, nodata. Other values are rejected.

interval.description: Re-notification interval as a Go duration string (e.g. 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h).

usePolicy.description: v2 threshold_rule/promql_rule routing mode only. false (default) requires at least one nonblank valid channel on every threshold tier. true routes through the org-level policy matching on labels, so threshold channels may be omitted; every supplied threshold channel name is still validated. Top-level preferredChannels is rejected in both modes.

preferredChannels.description: v1 anomaly_rule direct routing only. Use at least one nonblank exact name. Reuse a fully paginated signoz_list_notification_channels result only from the same still-current prepared operation; otherwise call it, refreshing if state may have changed. Never guess. Omit for v2 threshold/promql rules; use each tier's channels or confirmed notificationSettings.usePolicy=true.

ruleType.description: Evaluation type: threshold_rule (compare against value) or promql_rule (PromQL expression) or anomaly_rule (anomaly detection on metrics).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Set to v2alpha1 automatically for threshold_rule/promql_rule. Must be omitted (or empty) for anomaly_rule.

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

source.description: Source URL for the alert. Set automatically.

version.description: API version. Always v5. Set automatically if omitted.

tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change an existing SigNoz dashboard. This is a full replacement, not a partial patch: fetch it with signoz_get_dashboard, take the "data" object out of that response, merge only the requested changes into it, and preserve every other field. Send that object's fields at the top level; the {status, data} response envelope is not accepted as input. For small, targeted edits prefer signoz_patch_dashboard, which avoids re-sending the whole dashboard. Use signoz_update_view instead for a saved Explorer query. Before composing changed panels, read signoz://dashboard/instructions, signoz://dashboard/widgets-instructions, and signoz://dashboard/widgets-examples, then follow the query-specific resource linked by the widget guide.

fillLessThan.description: The maximum gap size to connect when fillOnlyBelow is true. Gaps larger than this duration are left disconnected.

fillOnlyBelow.description: Controls whether lines connect across null values. When false (default), all gaps are connected. When true, only gaps smaller than fillLessThan are connected.

Querybuildertypesv5CompositeQuery.description: Composite query containing one or more query envelopes. Each query envelope specifies its type and corresponding spec.

Querybuildertypesv5Step.description: Step interval. Accepts a Go duration string (e.g., "60s", "1m", "1h") or a number representing seconds (e.g., 60).

searchContext.description: The user's original question or search text that triggered this tool call. Always include the user's raw query here for better results.

uuid.description: Legacy alias for id; accepted for backward compatibility.

tools.description:
Use this when the user wants to change an existing SigNoz notification channel. This is a full replacement: first find the ID with signoz_list_notification_channels, then call signoz_get_notification_channel and merge the requested change while preserving the complete provider configuration and send_resolved value. Omitting send_resolved resets it to true. A test notification is sent after update; an update can succeed even when that test fails, which is reported in the response.
SUPPORTED TYPES: slack, webhook, pagerduty, email, opsgenie, msteams

Do not use this for partial updates.

email_html.description: Custom HTML email template (Go template syntax supported)

email_to.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses. Required when type=email

id.description: Notification channel UUID. Obtain it from signoz_list_notification_channels.

msteams_text.description: Message body template (Go template syntax supported)

msteams_title.description: Message title template (Go template syntax supported)

msteams_webhook_url.description: MS Teams incoming webhook URL. Required when type=msteams

name.description: Complete replacement channel name. Preserve the current name unless the user requested a change.

opsgenie_api_key.description: OpsGenie API key. Required when type=opsgenie

opsgenie_priority.description: Alert priority: P1, P2, P3, P4, or P5

pagerduty_routing_key.description: PagerDuty integration/routing key. Required when type=pagerduty

pagerduty_severity.description: Incident severity: critical, error, warning, or info

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

send_resolved.description: Complete replacement resolved-notification setting. Copy the current value from signoz_get_notification_channel unless changing it; omission resets to true.

slack_api_url.description: Slack incoming webhook URL. Required when type=slack. Example: https://hooks.slack.com/services/T.../B.../xxx

slack_channel.description: Slack channel or username to post to. Example: '#alerts' or '@oncall'

slack_text.description: Message body template (Go template syntax supported)

slack_title.description: Message title template (Go template syntax supported)

type.description: Complete replacement channel type: slack, webhook, pagerduty, email, opsgenie, or msteams. Preserve the current type unless the user requested a change.

webhook_url.description: Webhook endpoint URL. Required when type=webhook

tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change an existing saved view. This is a full replacement: call signoz_get_view first, modify its data object, preserve every unrequested field, and pass that full object as view. Upstream keeps name immutable on update; the display name lives in spec.displayName. Read signoz://view/instructions and signoz://view/examples when changing source or spec. Keep the UUID only in id; omit server-populated IDs and timestamps from view.

id.description: UUID of the view to replace. Required.

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

view.description: Complete saved view after the requested changes. Start with the data returned by signoz_get_view and pass the full object here.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the view spec. Default: "v2".

source.description: Which Explorer this view belongs to. One of: "traces", "logs", "metrics", "meter", "ai_observability". Use "meter" for Cost Meter views (queried as metrics with source "meter").

spec.description: The saved-view spec object: displayName, panelType, requestType, queries, selectedFields, and display. See signoz://view/instructions and signoz://view/examples.
